findings.highlight: The sound of the door opening follows
findings.evidenceJa: 間髪いれずに響く扉の音
findings.governingReading: The door sounds immediately, without a moment’s interval after Shirou hides.
findings.explanation: Follows removes the instantaneous timing that makes his poor hiding place urgent and comic.

findings.highlight: Ha, this is soft and perfect
findings.governingReading: Shirou stammers that the bed is f-fluffy and perfect.
findings.explanation: Ha misreads the repeated first syllable as laughter and loses his nervous fixation on the bedding.

findings.evidenceJa: 完全なる密室トリック
findings.governingReading: Shirou grandiosely calls his sheet disguise a perfect locked-room trick.
findings.explanation: Closed door trick is not the locked-room mystery idiom and blunts the joke’s inflated self-assessment.

findings.governingReading: Saber addresses Shirou in a voice of complete exasperation at his obvious hiding attempt.
findings.explanation: Astonished makes her surprised rather than fed up, changing her reaction and their comic dynamic.

findings.highlight: I take my face out of the soft bed
findings.governingReading: Shirou pokes his face or head out of the fluffy bed.
findings.explanation: Take my face out is non-English and treats his face like a detachable object.

findings.governingReading: Shirou stammers as he crawls out of bed.

findings.highlight: This is no place for you
findings.evidenceJa: 今のセイバーが近寄っていい場所じゃない
findings.governingReading: Shirou says Illya’s hideout is no place for Saber to approach in her present weakened condition.
findings.explanation: Across the third branch, the English again removes the physical condition behind his concern.
